title: Script Editor Opens Unwantedly On Switching Tabs
body:
### Tested versions

4.6 stable
4.7 stable

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 28000) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1062) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-14700K (28 threads) - 31.69 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Script editor opens unwantedly.

it is kind of duplicate of :
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/120699

but , this is not only for external editor , it happens in internal and external editor.

### Steps to reproduce

-create any 2 scenes and open them in 2 tabs.
-create a script for a node in first scene. script editor opens(which is good).
-go back to 3D or 2D view.
-if you clicked on script icon  the script editor opens(which is good)
-change current scene view to 3D or 2D , then open other scene by clicking on .tscn file , or just clicking on second scene tab.
- now go back to first scene
- you can see that it opens script editor automatically instead of 3D or 2D(which is bad)
(no matter using External script editor or Godot's script editor)
(no matter using GDScripts or C#)


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[BugReport.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29660130/BugReport.zip)

in sent project(BugReport):


-click on script icon of "Node3D" node.
-change view to 3D
-change tab to "scene_2" scene
-change tab back to "node_3d" scene
-script editor opens automatically (instead of opening 3D view)
